purpose: Construct a non-bimodal selector pool without conditioning task choice on selector scores.
rules: The task-state cell, K, intervention and thresholds are frozen before outcomes.
Clean competence is an eligibility check, not evidence that a selector is better.
All 0/K and K/K stress outcomes remain in the report.
No attribution, effect, value or outcome score may change membership after launch.
Sentinels validate infrastructure but do not count as new independent cells.
Selector weights remain frozen; this protocol only constructs an evaluation pool.
